items.subject: West Palm Beach new-construction buyer notes
items.intro: Here are the latest West Palm Beach development notes to help buyers compare timing, corridor fit, and what should be verified before touring.

storyBlurbs.headline: Mandarin Oriental releases a clearer interior design signal
storyBlurbs.blurb: New Mandarin Oriental renderings give buyers a better read on the project's branded-service and interior-design positioning along North Flagler.
storyBlurbs.cta: Compare Mandarin Oriental with North Flagler alternatives

storyBlurbs.headline: NORA House sharpens the downtown/NORA buyer thesis
storyBlurbs.blurb: NORA House gives buyers a walkability-first alternative to Flagler Drive, with the district story becoming as important as the building itself.
storyBlurbs.cta: Compare NORA House with downtown and waterfront options

storyBlurbs.headline: In West Palm Beach, luxury condo now means vertical resort
storyBlurbs.blurb: West Palm Beach luxury condo development is shifting from nice building to vertical resort.
storyBlurbs.cta: Brooke Snader with the Scott Gordon Group at Douglas Elliman Palm Beach helps buyers compare West Palm Beach new-construction condos across buildings and corridors.

storyBlurbs.headline: NORA is moving from restaurant buzz to residential gravity
storyBlurbs.blurb: NORA is becoming one of the key lifestyle corridors to watch in West Palm Beach.
storyBlurbs.cta: Brooke Snader with the Scott Gordon Group at Douglas Elliman Palm Beach can help compare NORA, North Flagler, South Flagler, and Downtown based on lifestyle, timing, views, amenities, and long-term fit.

storyBlurbs.headline: Ritz-Carlton Residences moves into construction-stage review
storyBlurbs.blurb: The Ritz-Carlton Residences West Palm Beach groundbreaking gives buyers a clearer construction and team signal for the North Flagler shortlist.
storyBlurbs.cta: Compare Ritz-Carlton Residences with active North Flagler alternatives

storyBlurbs.headline: Rosewood adds another branded North Flagler signal
storyBlurbs.blurb: Rosewood Residences points to more branded luxury supply on North Flagler, but buyers should treat it as a future project until buyer-ready details are confirmed.
storyBlurbs.cta: Separate future pipeline from active inventory
